posts.zh:
dsh-md-preview 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。把 Markdown 渲染为自包含的独立 HTML 页面：提供在 headless 配置下同样可用的 `md_html_render` 工具，以及在网页端浏览、预览、编辑并导出本地 `.md` 文件的抽屉；两个入口共用同一个渲染器，无运行时依赖。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e50e545d789864810526.html
posts.en:
dsh-md-preview is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Render Markdown to a standalone, self-contained HTML page: an `md_html_render` tool that works in a headless profile, plus a web drawer to browse, preview, edit and export local `.md` files; both share one renderer, with no runtime dependencies.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e50e545d789864810526.html
